I can't verify the co-inventor of this 1947 patent, so I can't name one with confidence. The shared note's description is also wrong: Irving Langmuir won the 1932 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, and Bernard Vonnegut did not. If forced to choose, I'd lean toward Langmuir, but a patent database search for the title and Schaefer as inventor would settle it.

CONFIDENCE: 20
